change.title: Stripe.js: deprecated Payment Intents/Setup Intents/Sources methods removed; initCheckout and initEmbeddedCheckout renamed; elements.update() returns a Promise

source.quote: Removes deprecated Payment Intents, Setup Intents, and Sources methods from Stripe.js

tasks.reasoning:
The UI loads Stripe.js through @stripe/stripe-js 7.8.0 and @stripe/react-stripe-js 5.4.1, which pin the basil Stripe.js. Dahlia removes deprecated PaymentIntent/SetupIntent/Sources methods, renames initCheckout/initEmbeddedCheckout, and makes elements.update() return a Promise. Endive deprecates the payment request button and changes handleNextAction, canConfirm and validation behaviour. None of this breaks today because the loaded Stripe.js version is pinned by the package. It all lands when the UI moves to a dahlia/endive Stripe.js, in three copies of the pricing table (src and two public standalones). The usage map did not read which Stripe.js methods are called, so the migration agent must grep for: handleCardPayment, confirmCardPayment-era methods, createSource, initCheckout, paymentRequestButton, handleNextAction, elements.update and paymentMethodTypes. It should then upgrade both packages together.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-stripejs-payment-request-button (other): Stripe.js: payment request button deprecated; handleNextAction UI, canConfirm, address and billing-details validation behaviour changes in Elements, effective 2026-09-30. Also a Stripe.js behaviour change. It only takes effect when @stripe/stripe-js and react-stripe-js are moved past the basil-pinned 7.8.0, so the same UI upgrade must check for paymentRequestButton, handleNextAction and canConfirm usage.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog.md
  "Deprecates the payment request button"
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. No server call site creates Checkout Sessions (the map shows no checkout.sessions call). The part that can touch this repo is the removed paymentMethodTypes option on Elements deferred intents, which only matters when Stripe.js is upgraded. The same UI upgrade should grep the pricing tables for paymentMethodTypes, and any payment_method_types on checkout.sessions.create if one exists outside the map.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"

callSites.why: loadStripe: the Stripe.js version loaded changes on upgrade, and deprecated PaymentIntent/SetupIntent methods are removed.
loadStripe for the portal setup-intent flow; confirmSetup and handleCardSetup-style calls must use the surviving methods.
useStripe/useElements payment flow: check for removed methods, the elements.update() Promise return, and paymentMethodTypes options.
useStripe/useElements in the second flow; same checks.
Hand-bundled standalone copy of the same Stripe.js flow; must be kept in sync.
useStripe/useElements in the JSX standalone copy.

## Stripe.js: deprecated Payment Intents/Setup Intents/Sources methods removed; initCheckout and initEmbeddedCheckout renamed; elements.update() returns a Promise [Not affected]

### Change

No code changes. Grepped the three pricing-table copies (src and two public standalones) for the removed or changed Stripe.js surface. The only Stripe.js calls are loadStripe, useStripe, useElements, stripe.confirmPayment and stripe.confirmSetup.

No files changed.

### Why

Dahlia removes the deprecated handleCardPayment-style, createSource and Sources methods, and renames initCheckout and initEmbeddedCheckout. It also makes elements.update() return a Promise. Endive deprecates paymentRequestButton, changes handleNextAction and canConfirm, and removes paymentMethodTypes. The repo uses none of these. confirmPayment and confirmSetup are not removed. The repo also has no elements.update calls and no checkout.sessions calls, so there is no payment_method_types to remove.

> Removes deprecated Payment Intents, Setup Intents, and Sources methods from Stripe.js

Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `cd common && npx tsc` (api and ui import @lumen/common from its dist output (main/types/exports point to ./dist), so typecheck needs common built first; the root build script does this itself but typecheck does not); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `cd common && npx tsc` (Builds common/dist, which api and ui import as @lumen/common (its package.json points main and types at dist).); it exited 0.
- Before the baseline the harness ran `cd api && npx tsc -b` (ui references the api project and imports its route types. The TS6305 error says api/dist/src/routes/index.d.ts has not been built, so this emits those declarations.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_UI_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_LUMEN_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- I did not run the build or tests, since nothing changed.
- The grep only matched the three pricing-table files and the pricing-table.json registry copy, which I did not read in full. I did not search the rest of the repo.
- When @stripe/stripe-js and @stripe/react-stripe-js are later upgraded past the basil-pinned versions, the Elements behaviour changes (validation, handleNextAction UI) have not been tested.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

change.title: stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields

source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The API uses stripe-node 17.7.0 (default API version 2025-02-24.acacia, also pinned explicitly in a script). The node 19–23 majors all lie between the current SDK and the latest, and node 23 pins 2026-09-30.endive. One coherent PR should cover all of it: bump to 23; construct the client with `new Stripe()` (22); fix type fallout including Stripe.Decimal (21) and the reworked types (22); keep webhooks.constructEventAsync as the verification path; and audit server-side PaymentIntent/SetupIntent creation for payment_method_types, which returns a 400 under endive. Nothing breaks today because older API versions keep working and the SDK is pinned. The risk sits in the payment and webhook paths once the bump is made, so it is medium priority and should be planned around the endive date. The agent should also check whether merchant webhook endpoints should carry an explicit api_version so incoming event shapes match the SDK types.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. The repo is on stripe-node 17.7.0. Moving to 23 crosses 19; the parseThinEvent rename and V2 delete types apply only within that upgrade, and 19.x itself is skipped.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. Crossed by the move to 23. V2 indexed array serialization only matters for mock-server tests, which the upgrade's test run will reveal.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. Crossed by the move to 23. It needs checks on decimal_string becoming Stripe.Decimal and on the stricter webhook parsing method; the repo uses webhooks.constructEventAsync.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. Crossed by the move to 23. Stripe client construction must use `new Stripe()`, and the reworked types may break test helpers.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23 pins 2026-09-30.endive, so the SDK bump is the API-version move.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. An intermediate API version that is skipped over by moving straight to endive via node 23. Its server-side items (ui_mode, events_from, capability risk requirements) are not used by the repo.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-intents (field-removed): payment_method_types no longer writable on PaymentIntents and SetupIntents (400 error) in 2026-09-30.endive, effective 2026-09-30. Bites only on endive. The repo creates PaymentIntents and SetupIntents server-side (public payment-init, portal create-setup-intent), but those create calls are not in the map. The upgrade must grep paymentprovider.ts and routes for payment_method_types on paymentIntents.create/update/confirm and setupIntents.create and drop them or switch to automatic_payment_methods.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/removes-the-payment-method-types-parameter-from-payment-intents-and-setup-intents.md
  "Passing `payment_method_types` on this API version returns a 400 error with the code `payment_method_types_no_longer_supported`."
- stripe:2026-09-30-other-breaking-endive (other): Other breaking Endive 2026-09-30 items (unsure which apply): BLIK decline codes, eventually-due requirement errors on Accounts, Failed Tax Calculation error, SEPA debit settings in Accounts, Payment Evaluation nullable scores, 3DS Data Share Only, dispute evidence page limit, India mandates, effective 2026-09-30. Endive-only behaviour. accounts.retrieve responses (eventually-due requirement errors) and payment failure handling (BLIK decline codes) should be checked as part of the same version bump; most items (Tax, Payment Evaluation, 3DS share, India mandates) are unlikely to apply.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog.md
  "Returns specific decline codes for BLIK payment failures"

callSites.why: Explicit apiVersion pin 2025-02-24.acacia; must be updated or removed to match the new SDK's types.

Webhook handler parses Stripe.Event and verifies via webhooks.constructEventAsync (paymentprovider.ts:1659). Event types and the webhook-parsing changes in 21/23 apply, and payloads follow the endpoint's API version.
webhookEndpoints.create registers merchant endpoints. Event payload shape depends on the API version, so the agent should consider setting api_version explicitly so payloads match the new SDK types.
accounts.retrieve: response types and requirement errors change under endive.
paymentIntents.confirm in test helpers: payment_method_types is rejected on confirm under endive, and the reworked types may affect the helpers.
setupIntents.confirm: same type and param checks.
webhookEndpoints.del: return types reworked in node 22/23; verify compile.

## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Verified]

### Change

Bumped stripe 17.7.0 to 23.0.0 (ui/package.json and bun.lock, the only place stripe is declared). Changed every apiVersion pin from 2025-02-24.acacia to 2026-09-30.endive across api/src, api/tests and scripts. Replaced accounts.retrieve() with accounts.retrieveCurrent() in src/routes/stripe.ts, src/routes/merchants.ts and the generate scripts. Removed payment_method_types from the paymentIntents.create and setupIntents.create calls in paymentprovider.ts. Fixed the require("stripe") in tests/scripts/generate.ts to use .default. Added api/tests/unit/stripe-v23.test.ts. The repo has no uses of constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType, parseThinEvent or V2 list types. The ui typecheck errors all trace back to TS6305: ui imports api route types through a project reference, and api/dist declarations were never built. review.summary: The SDK bump and `apiVersion` pin look consistent. Because typecheck passes, every typed `new Stripe(...)` should now accept `2026-09-30.endive`. The quoted removal of `constructEventWithoutVerification` does not appear to touch this repo. The PR also changes runtime behaviour beyond what the SDK forces, and none of it is exercised. The account version moves from acacia to endive, `payment_method_types: ["card"]` is removed from production intent creation, and `accounts.retrieve()` becomes `retrieveCurrent()`. The checks are only typecheck, build and a grep-style proof test, so they show nothing about live Stripe behaviour. The 'verified' grade overstates what was checked.

concerns.issue: Lines ~2106 and ~2114 remove `payment_method_types: ["card"]` from `paymentIntents.create` and `setupIntents.create`. This is a product behaviour change, not something the quoted changelog forces. Without it, Stripe may fall back to the merchant's dashboard-configured payment methods, so non-card methods (bank debits, wallets, redirect-based methods) could be offered. Downstream code and webhook handling may assume a card. I could not confirm that endive makes this parameter invalid; check the 23.0.0 changelog and the API upgrade guide. If it is not required, keep it.

Moving the pinned version from 2025-02-24.acacia to 2026-09-30.endive changes request and response semantics for every production Stripe call. That covers intents, customers and payment methods across the basil/clover/dahlia/endive breaking changes. No integration test against Stripe ran. Typecheck only shows the shapes match the SDK typings, not that runtime behaviour such as statuses, expansions or defaults is unchanged.

`accounts.retrieve()` becomes `accounts.retrieveCurrent()` here (line ~95), in merchants.ts:474 and in the generate scripts. The rename typechecks, so the method exists in the v23 typings, but I could not confirm from the quoted source that no-arg `retrieve()` was removed. Confirm against the SDK's `AccountsResource` types. The key-validation and merchant-data endpoints depend on this call and are untested.

The webhook handler at line 2699 is not shown or changed. Webhook endpoints created in stripe.ts:176 set no `api_version`, so live event payloads follow the account default version, not endive. The handler may now face a mismatch between the SDK's endive `Stripe.Event` types and the shape of payloads actually received. The test-only `stripe-mock.ts` change to `api_version: endive` hides this. Also confirm the handler does not use the removed `ErrorType` export or `constructEventWithoutVerification`, for example through `any`-typed code.

Line ~1062 changes `require("stripe")` to `const { default: Stripe } = require("stripe")`. This `require` is untyped, so typecheck does not cover it. If v23's CJS export does not expose `.default`, the script fails at runtime. This was not exercised.

The lockfile has unrelated drift: a `configVersion` key appears, `qs` is removed, and `@lumen/ui/react-dom@19.1.2` is added. Only `ui/package.json` declares stripe. The `api` workspace imports stripe without declaring it in this diff, so it appears to rely on hoisting from ui. The version is also pinned exactly to 23.0.0 instead of a caret range.

The proof test only greps source strings and reads `../node_modules/stripe/package.json`. It asserts that `payment_method_types` is absent, which locks in the behaviour change instead of verifying correctness. It does not support a 'verified' grade.
